summary: Fox Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an $8.4 billion seven-tranche senior unsecured note offering spanning 2029 to 2066 maturities, with coupons from 5.625% to 7.300%. Proceeds, plus cash on hand, repay the Bridge Facility used to fund part of the cash consideration for Fox's completed Roku acquisition, closed November 6, 2026. Notes rank pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, are unguaranteed by subsidiaries, and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase right. This is routine investment-grade debt financing of a prior deal, not a new special situation; watch leverage and integration.
